package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"math"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const MasteryPolicyVersion = "student-mastery-v1"

// LearningEvidenceClass freezes whether a task checks knowledge or applies it.
// The value is derived from trusted Course metadata when the action opens.
type LearningEvidenceClass string

const (
	LearningEvidenceKnowledgeCheck LearningEvidenceClass = "knowledge_check"
	LearningEvidenceApplication    LearningEvidenceClass = "application"
)

// LearningActionOutcome is the immutable official result of one action cycle.
type LearningActionOutcome string

const (
	LearningActionPassed LearningActionOutcome = "passed"
	LearningActionFailed LearningActionOutcome = "failed"
)

// LearningActionTargetEvidenceKind is the normalized combination of the
// student-owned outcome and teacher-owned assistance context.
type LearningActionTargetEvidenceKind string

const (
	EvidenceFailedKnowledgeCheck     LearningActionTargetEvidenceKind = "failed_knowledge_check"
	EvidenceAssistedUnderstanding    LearningActionTargetEvidenceKind = "assisted_understanding"
	EvidenceIndependentUnderstanding LearningActionTargetEvidenceKind = "independent_understanding"
	EvidenceFailedApplication        LearningActionTargetEvidenceKind = "failed_application"
	EvidenceAssistedApplication      LearningActionTargetEvidenceKind = "assisted_application"
	EvidenceIndependentApplication   LearningActionTargetEvidenceKind = "independent_application"
)

// TargetMasteryState is the student-owned mastery projection for one exact target.
type TargetMasteryState string

const (
	TargetMasteryUnknown    TargetMasteryState = "UNKNOWN"
	TargetMasteryExposed    TargetMasteryState = "EXPOSED"
	TargetMasteryUnderstood TargetMasteryState = "UNDERSTOOD"
	TargetMasteryPracticed  TargetMasteryState = "PRACTICED"
	TargetMasteryApplied    TargetMasteryState = "APPLIED"
	TargetMasteryMastered   TargetMasteryState = "MASTERED"
)

// LearningActionTargetEvidence is one immutable, policy-versioned reducer input.
type LearningActionTargetEvidence struct {
	LearningActionID     string
	StudentID            string
	TaskID               string
	Target               LearningTargetRef
	EvidenceClass        LearningEvidenceClass
	Outcome              LearningActionOutcome
	SupportContext       TeacherSupportContext
	Kind                 LearningActionTargetEvidenceKind
	HintsUsed            int
	MaxHintLevel         *int
	InterventionUsed     bool
	TeacherPolicyVersion string
	MasteryPolicyVersion string
	OccurredAt           time.Time
}

// StudentTargetMastery is the deterministic current projection over all
// normalized action evidence for one exact target identity.
type StudentTargetMastery struct {
	StudentID               string
	Target                  LearningTargetRef
	State                   TargetMasteryState
	MasteryScore            float64
	Confidence              float64
	IndependentSuccessCount int
	AssistedSuccessCount    int
	FailureCount            int
	EvidenceCount           int
	LastSeenAt              time.Time
	LastPracticedAt         *time.Time
	LastFailedAt            *time.Time
	PolicyVersion           string
}

// LearningActionOutcomeForAnswerStatus maps the authoritative terminal answer
// status to an immutable action result.
func LearningActionOutcomeForAnswerStatus(status int) (LearningActionOutcome, error) {
	switch status {
	case StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed:
		return LearningActionPassed, nil
	case StudentTaskAnswerStatusFailed:
		return LearningActionFailed, nil
	default:
		return "", errors.New("learning action requires a terminal answer status")
	}
}

// BuildLearningActionTargetEvidence validates the action/assistance join and
// derives one objective evidence row per frozen target. Legacy actions without
// an evidence class or immutable outcome remain assistance-only.
func BuildLearningActionTargetEvidence(action StudentLearningAction, assistance TeacherAssistance) ([]LearningActionTargetEvidence, error) {
	if action.ID != assistance.LearningActionID || action.StudentID != assistance.StudentID ||
		action.ContextType != assistance.ContextType || action.ContextID != assistance.ContextID ||
		action.ClosedAt == nil || action.ClosedAt.IsZero() {
		return nil, errors.New("teacher assistance does not match the closed learning action")
	}
	targets, err := NormalizeLearningTargetRefs(action.LearningTargets)
	if err != nil || len(targets) == 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("teacher assistance requires the action target snapshot")
	}
	observedTargets := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
	for _, observation := range assistance.Observations {
		normalizedTarget, normalizeErr := NormalizeLearningTargetRef(observation.Target)
		if normalizeErr != nil {
			return nil, errors.New("teacher assistance contains an invalid target")
		}
		observedTargets[targetIdentity(normalizedTarget)] = struct{}{}
	}
	if len(observedTargets) != len(targets) {
		return nil, errors.New("teacher assistance target set does not match the action snapshot")
	}
	for _, target := range targets {
		if _, exists := observedTargets[targetIdentity(target)]; !exists {
			return nil, errors.New("teacher assistance target set does not match the action snapshot")
		}
	}

	// Existing actions created before the evidence policy was deployed cannot be
	// classified safely. Preserve their assistance facts without inventing mastery.
	if action.EvidenceClass == "" || action.Outcome == "" {
		return nil, nil
	}
	if !validLearningEvidenceClass(action.EvidenceClass) || !validLearningActionOutcome(action.Outcome) ||
		strings.TrimSpace(action.OutcomePolicyVersion) != MasteryPolicyVersion {
		return nil, errors.New("learning action outcome policy is invalid")
	}

	kind, err := deriveTargetEvidenceKind(action.EvidenceClass, action.Outcome, assistance.SupportContext)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	result := make([]LearningActionTargetEvidence, 0, len(targets))
	for _, target := range targets {
		result = append(result, LearningActionTargetEvidence{
			LearningActionID:     action.ID,
			StudentID:            action.StudentID,
			TaskID:               action.TaskID,
			Target:               target,
			EvidenceClass:        action.EvidenceClass,
			Outcome:              action.Outcome,
			SupportContext:       assistance.SupportContext,
			Kind:                 kind,
			HintsUsed:            assistance.HintsUsed,
			MaxHintLevel:         assistance.MaxHintLevel,
			InterventionUsed:     assistance.InterventionUsed,
			TeacherPolicyVersion: assistance.PolicyVersion,
			MasteryPolicyVersion: MasteryPolicyVersion,
			OccurredAt:           action.ClosedAt.UTC(),
		})
	}
	return result, nil
}

// ReduceStudentTargetMastery recomputes a replay-safe v1 projection. The
// reducer is intentionally cumulative and monotonic; later policy versions may
// add time decay or explicit reassessment without rewriting v1 evidence.
func ReduceStudentTargetMastery(evidence []LearningActionTargetEvidence) (StudentTargetMastery, error) {
	if len(evidence) == 0 {
		return StudentTargetMastery{}, errors.New("mastery evidence is required")
	}
	first := evidence[0]
	if first.StudentID == "" {
		return StudentTargetMastery{}, errors.New("mastery evidence student is required")
	}
	target, err := NormalizeLearningTargetRef(first.Target)
	if err != nil {
		return StudentTargetMastery{}, err
	}

	projection := StudentTargetMastery{
		StudentID:     first.StudentID,
		Target:        target,
		State:         TargetMasteryExposed,
		PolicyVersion: MasteryPolicyVersion,
	}
	seenActions := make(map[string]struct{}, len(evidence))
	independentApplicationTasks := make(map[string]struct{})
	applicationEvidence := 0
	understandingSuccess := 0
	independentApplications := 0

	for _, item := range evidence {
		normalizedTarget, targetErr := NormalizeLearningTargetRef(item.Target)
		expectedKind, kindErr := deriveTargetEvidenceKind(item.EvidenceClass, item.Outcome, item.SupportContext)
		if targetErr != nil || item.StudentID != projection.StudentID || targetIdentity(normalizedTarget) != targetIdentity(target) ||
			item.LearningActionID == "" || item.TaskID == "" || strings.TrimSpace(item.TeacherPolicyVersion) == "" ||
			item.MasteryPolicyVersion != MasteryPolicyVersion || item.OccurredAt.IsZero() || kindErr != nil || expectedKind != item.Kind {
			return StudentTargetMastery{}, errors.New("inconsistent mastery evidence")
		}
		if _, duplicate := seenActions[item.LearningActionID]; duplicate {
			return StudentTargetMastery{}, errors.New("duplicate action mastery evidence")
		}
		seenActions[item.LearningActionID] = struct{}{}
		projection.EvidenceCount++
		if projection.LastSeenAt.IsZero() || item.OccurredAt.After(projection.LastSeenAt) {
			projection.LastSeenAt = item.OccurredAt.UTC()
		}
		if item.EvidenceClass == LearningEvidenceApplication {
			applicationEvidence++
			if projection.LastPracticedAt == nil || item.OccurredAt.After(*projection.LastPracticedAt) {
				occurredAt := item.OccurredAt.UTC()
				projection.LastPracticedAt = &occurredAt
			}
		}

		switch item.Kind {
		case EvidenceIndependentUnderstanding:
			projection.IndependentSuccessCount++
			understandingSuccess++
		case EvidenceIndependentApplication:
			projection.IndependentSuccessCount++
			independentApplications++
			independentApplicationTasks[item.TaskID] = struct{}{}
		case EvidenceAssistedUnderstanding:
			projection.AssistedSuccessCount++
			understandingSuccess++
		case EvidenceAssistedApplication:
			projection.AssistedSuccessCount++
		case EvidenceFailedKnowledgeCheck, EvidenceFailedApplication:
			projection.FailureCount++
			if projection.LastFailedAt == nil || item.OccurredAt.After(*projection.LastFailedAt) {
				occurredAt := item.OccurredAt.UTC()
				projection.LastFailedAt = &occurredAt
			}
		}
	}

	if independentApplications >= 3 && len(independentApplicationTasks) >= 2 {
		projection.State = TargetMasteryMastered
	} else if independentApplications > 0 {
		projection.State = TargetMasteryApplied
	} else if applicationEvidence > 0 {
		projection.State = TargetMasteryPracticed
	} else if understandingSuccess > 0 {
		projection.State = TargetMasteryUnderstood
	}

	projection.MasteryScore = roundMastery(
		(float64(projection.IndependentSuccessCount) + 0.5*float64(projection.AssistedSuccessCount)) /
			float64(projection.EvidenceCount),
	)
	projection.Confidence = roundMastery(float64(projection.EvidenceCount) / float64(projection.EvidenceCount+2))
	return projection, nil
}

func deriveTargetEvidenceKind(class LearningEvidenceClass, outcome LearningActionOutcome, support TeacherSupportContext) (LearningActionTargetEvidenceKind, error) {
	if !validLearningEvidenceClass(class) || !validLearningActionOutcome(outcome) || !validTeacherSupportContext(support) {
		return "", errors.New("invalid learning evidence inputs")
	}
	if class == LearningEvidenceKnowledgeCheck {
		if outcome == LearningActionFailed {
			return EvidenceFailedKnowledgeCheck, nil
		}
		if support == TeacherSupportIndependent {
			return EvidenceIndependentUnderstanding, nil
		}
		return EvidenceAssistedUnderstanding, nil
	}
	if outcome == LearningActionFailed {
		return EvidenceFailedApplication, nil
	}
	if support == TeacherSupportIndependent {
		return EvidenceIndependentApplication, nil
	}
	return EvidenceAssistedApplication, nil
}

func targetIdentity(target LearningTargetRef) string {
	return string(target.Type) + "\x00" + target.Key + "\x00" + target.Version
}

func validLearningEvidenceClass(value LearningEvidenceClass) bool {
	return value == LearningEvidenceKnowledgeCheck || value == LearningEvidenceApplication
}

// IsLearningEvidenceClass reports whether a persisted action classification is supported.
func IsLearningEvidenceClass(value LearningEvidenceClass) bool {
	return validLearningEvidenceClass(value)
}

func validLearningActionOutcome(value LearningActionOutcome) bool {
	return value == LearningActionPassed || value == LearningActionFailed
}

// IsLearningActionOutcome reports whether a persisted terminal outcome is supported.
func IsLearningActionOutcome(value LearningActionOutcome) bool {
	return validLearningActionOutcome(value)
}

func roundMastery(value float64) float64 {
	return math.Round(value*100000) / 100000
}
